description: Resolve an Australian postcode to its suburbs and state, or a suburb name to its postcode. Works in both directions. Use it to validate an address before quoting, or when a suburb name is ambiguous because the same name exists in several states.

query.description: An Australian postcode such as 3000, or a suburb name such as Carlton.

state.description: Optional state filter: NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, NT or ACT. Supply it when a suburb name exists in more than one state.

name: lookup_au_postcode
title: Look up an Australian postcode or suburb
